summary: Goldgroup Mining, a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing a November 3, 2026 news release and an October 23, 2026 Material Change Report. The disclosure announces the Company's inclusion in the Solactive Global Silver Miners Index effective November 2, 2026, an index tracked by the Global X Silver Miners ETF (SIL). No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. Management frames inclusion as a visibility milestone supporting its strategy of building an intermediate precious-metals producer across Mexican and Michigan assets. No structural or regulatory mechanics apply; the event carries no deal-arb angle.
